_metadata.description: SQLite-backed verification run history: schema, migration, repository, service.

requirements.title: Migration 0001 creates verification_runs table
requirements.description: api/internal/<domain>/migrations/0001_verification_runs.sql creates verification_runs with id, flow_id, hashes, status, counterexample, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, plus an idx_runs_flow_id index.

validation.notes: Repository test against in-memory SQLite (file::memory:?cache=shared) asserts schema and indexes.

requirements.title: Every verification writes one row
requirements.description: verify run and verify check each persist exactly one row per flow per invocation. Status is one of passed/failed/error.

validation.notes: Integration test confirms a row appears after each verify invocation.

requirements.title: CLI and HTTP expose history
requirements.description: flow-verifier runs list/show plus GET /api/v1/runs and /api/v1/runs/:id return persisted history with optional flowId filter.

validation.notes: Handler test + CLI test covering both shapes.
